## Problem

What is missing? Link related issues or documentation.

## Proposed change

Name the files you expect to change and keep the scope small.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe the expected behavior, finding/exit code, or documentation result.

## Verification

Which existing test or command will verify the change?

Use synthetic or sanitized data. Credit sources and preserve licenses.
